governed_suppressions_reason: jgates ci reports every suppression comment of the analyzed commit
governed_suppressions_done: {files} file(s) read: {count} suppression comment(s), {blocking} still honored by a check of this run
governed_suppressions_skipped: {count} file(s) over the size limit were not read: {files}
governed_suppressions_truncated: The commit has more than {count} files: the suppression comments could not all be read
governed_linters_unreadable: The list of MegaLinter's linters could not be read: {detail}
governed_suppression_neutralized: {tool} suppression comment: ignored by jgates ci ({how}); what it hid is reported anyway
governed_suppression_honored: {tool} suppression comment still honored by {by}: it may hide a finding; only a waiver of the CI policy accepts it
governed_suppression_honored_untrusted: {tool} suppression comment honored by {by}, a self-reported stage: its result does not approve alone
governed_suppression_unused: {tool} suppression comment: no check of this run reads it
governed_coverage_from_commit: The analyzed commit carries coverage reports ({files}): jgates ci never accepts evidence files supplied by the analyzed project
governed_adapter_excluded: jgates ci does not run {adapter} (instance {tool}): {why}. Turn it off in the policy, or use the quality gate subcheck, which runs with the packaged configuration
governed_adapter_unknown: the adapter is not in the trust table of jgates ci
governed_condition_self_reported: jgates ci: {adapter} runs code of the analyzed project, so its result is self-reported and does not approve alone (execution.trustSelfReported of the policy)
governed_eslint_no_policy_config: jgates ci: the instance {tool} has no configuration in the policy. Bind it in the policy's .jgates/tools.yml (tools.{tool}.config); the project's eslint.config is never used
governed_eslint_condition: jgates ci: uses only the policy's configuration ({file}) with --no-inline-config; ESLint is never the copy in the project's node_modules
governed_ruff_condition: jgates ci: uses only the policy's configuration ({config}), with --ignore-noqa and --no-respect-gitignore
governed_ruff_container_policy: jgates ci: the instance {tool} uses a configuration of the policy, which the container runner cannot mount. Run it on the local runner
governed_semgrep_condition: jgates ci: only the policy's rules, with --disable-nosem; .semgrepignore and .gitignore of the project are ignored
governed_excluded_gitleaks: Gitleaks reads .gitleaks.toml and .gitleaksignore from the scanned folder by itself
governed_excluded_trivy: Trivy reads trivy.yaml and .trivyignore from its working folder by itself
governed_excluded_osv-scanner: OSV-Scanner reads the osv-scanner.toml next to each lockfile by itself
governed_excluded_checkov: Checkov reads .checkov.yaml from its working folder by itself
governed_excluded_jscpd: jscpd reads .jscpd.json and the jscpd key of package.json from the analyzed folder
governed_excluded_import-linter: Import Linter reads its contracts from the project's .importlinter, setup.cfg or pyproject.toml
